tei:div.tei:p: bod kyi blon chen mdzangs pa mi bdun gyi byung tshul bzhugs so/ /oṃ swa ti/ bod du chos rgyal mi dbon rim pa yis/ /mnga' thang chab srid rigs mthun bsod nams las/ /sprul pa'i blon chen mdzangs la mang ba byon/ khyad par bod 'bangs byin la drin che ba'i/ /mdzangs pa mi bdun bya ba 'di ltar ro| |thog mar gri gum btsan po'i sras gsum gyis/ /bar pa spu te gung rgyal gyi sku ring la/ /gcig tu mdzangs pa chen po mdzangs kyi bu/ /ru las skyes kyi ngar gsos bya ba yin/ /de yis thabs dang las ka ci byas na/ /ba glang 'bri nag ra lug khrims su stsal/ /rtswa la chun po byas nas dbyar rtsigs dgun du stsal// spangs dang zhing du slog nas ri'i do rnams bzung*/ /de'i gong na bod na rtsi thog lo thog med/ khri snyan bzung btsan rgyal po'i sku ring la/ /gnyis su mdzangs pa blon chen khu yi bu/ /lha bu mgo dkar zhes pa de nyid byung*/ /de yis thabs dang las ka ci byas na/ /'brog gi don dang zhing gi mthun du 'debs/ /mtsho la gtar ka byas nas yur ba dkyus su bcug /phu chu rdzing du bskyil nas mtshan chu nyin du drangs/ /de'i gong na zhing rnams char mar 'debs/ /stag ri gnyan gzigs rgyal po'i sku ring la/ /gsum du mdzangs zhing mkhas pa mong gi bu/ khri do ri yi gnang tshab bya ba byung*/ /de yis thabs dang las ka ci byas na/ /rdo la sol bas bzhu nas gser dngul zangs lcags gton/ shing la bug pa phug nas shol dang 'asnya

kla gnya' blu shing bcas/ /mdzo glang dor du sdeb nas thang la thams cad btab/ /de'i gong na bod na rgal dang rin chen med/ /chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i sku ring la/ /bzhi ru mdzangs pa thon mi sam bho ṭa/ 'jam dbyangs sprul pa skye dgu'i sgron me des/ /'gro ba'i don la dka' ba dpag med kyi| |ka kha sum bcu bod kyi gug skyed bcas/ /'dogs dang 'brel sbyar tshag dang shad kyi bcad/ /tshig gi dbye nas skabs don smra ba brtsam/ /de gong bod na klaug dang yi ge med/ khri lde gtsug brtan rgyal po'i sku ring la/ /lnga ru mdzangs pa khri bzang yab don byung*/ /de'i thabs dang las ka ci byas na/ /bre dang srang gi 'du 'god gtsigs su bzung*/ /bre dang khyor gyi za ma zung tu 'dzin/ /dga' gnyis tshong byad mthun gnyis las la yod/ /de gong bod na bre srang nyo tshong med| |chos kyi rgyal po khri srong lde btsan ring*/ /drug tu mdzangs pa khri zang yab lhag byon/ /de'i thabs dang las ka ci byas na/ /ri khyim thams cad klung gi bde la phab/ /zhing mtha'i sgang la so nam khang khyim bcas/ /thang ma zhing du bslaugs nas chu rnams gzhung du bcug /de'i gong na ri la mkhar khyim 'dzin/ khri srong lde btsan 'phrul rgyal sku ring la/ /bdun du mdzangs pa chen po gnyer gyi bu/ /stab tshab gdong gcig bya ba de nyid byon/ /de'i thabs dang las ka ci byas na/ / phyogs bzhi'i srung mas sku'i rims gro byed/ /rgod kyi stong sdes so kha'i dgra la rgol| |nang gi khod snyoms khrims kyi bsos stong bcad/ /de'i gong na bod na bsos stong med/ /mdzangs pa mi bdun byung tshul de ltar lags// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed/mdzangs mi bdun gyi byung tshul/ -PAGE 136--PAGE 137-
